name: AI RSS Rewriter – Feed to Post, Autoblogging & SEO
author: Vanya

sections.description:
AI RSS Rewriter transforms RSS feed content into unique, SEO-optimized articles using advanced AI technologies. Perfect for content marketers, news websites, and bloggers who want to automate content creation while maintaining quality and uniqueness.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: External Service Dependency
This plugin requires an OpenAI API key to function. Without a valid API key, only basic RSS importing (Simple Mode) will be available. AI features including content rewriting, image generation, and SEO optimization require an active OpenAI subscription. Please ensure you have a valid OpenAI API key before using AI features.

Key Features

  • AI Content Rewriting: Transform RSS content into unique articles using GPT-4 and GPT-4o models
  • Custom AI Prompts: Create, test, and manage custom prompts for different content types
  • DALL-E 3 Image Generation: Generate contextual images for articles automatically
  • Smart Model Selection: Automatically choose optimal AI models based on content complexity
  • Budget Control: Set daily spending limits with real-time cost tracking
  • Image Optimization: WebP conversion and compression for better performance
  • Modern Admin Interface: Clean, responsive design with real-time statistics
  • Content Extraction: Extract full article content when RSS feeds provide only summaries
  • Flexible Post Dating: Use original RSS dates or current parsing time
  • SEO Optimization: Auto-generate meta descriptions and tags
  • Performance Optimized: Enhanced database queries and caching for better performance
  • WordPress Standards Compliant: Fully compliant with WordPress coding standards

Processing Modes

  • Simple Mode: Basic RSS importing without AI processing
  • AI Mode: Full enhancement with content rewriting, image generation, and SEO optimization

AI Models Supported

  • GPT-5 (Premium quality)
  • GPT-5 Mini (Recommended balance)
  • GPT-5 Nano (Fastest and most economical)
  • GPT-4o Mini (Fallback option)

Perfect For

  • News websites aggregating content from multiple sources
  • Content marketers scaling their content production
  • Bloggers wanting automated content with unique spin
  • SEO agencies managing multiple client feeds
  • Affiliate sites importing product information

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.0+ recommended)
  • OpenAI API key (REQUIRED for AI features) – Get your API key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
  • GD extension (for image optimization)
  • 128MB memory limit (256MB recommended)

OpenAI API Dependency Details:
– AI content rewriting requires GPT-4 or GPT-4o models
– Image generation requires DALL-E 3 access
– Estimated cost: $0.01-0.08 per article (depending on content length and features used)
– Without OpenAI API key: Only basic RSS importing available (Simple Mode)
– API key must have sufficient credits and proper permissions

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AI RSS Rewriter”
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin files
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ai-rss-rewriter/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Setup

  1. Go to AI RSS Rewriter in your admin menu
  2. Choose processing mode (Simple or AI)
  3. If using AI mode, enter your OpenAI API key
  4. Configure budget limits and processing preferences
  5. Add your first RSS feed
  6. Customize AI prompts if desired
  7. Start processing feeds automatically or manually
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Only for AI features. You can use Simple mode for basic RSS importing without AI processing.

How much does AI processing cost?

Costs depend on usage:
– Content rewriting: $0.01-0.05 per article
– Image generation: $0.04-0.08 per image
– Tags/SEO: $0.001-0.005 per article
Smart model selection can reduce costs by 40-60%.

Can I customize AI prompts?

Yes! The plugin includes a prompts manager where you can create, test, and manage custom prompts with variables like {title}, {content}, and {categories}.

What image formats are supported?

The plugin generates images with DALL-E 3 and can optimize them to WebP, JPEG, or PNG formats for better performance.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Yes, AI RSS Rewriter works with popular plugins including Yoast SEO, RankMath, WooCommerce, and major page builders.

How do I control costs?

Set daily budget limits, use smart model selection, and monitor real-time cost tracking in the dashboard.
